version.description: Config schema version (integer; distinct from the application version)

llm.description: Large language model configuration: a registry of arbitrarily-labeled backend configs plus a role→label map

configs.description: Labeled backend configs. The map key is an arbitrary user label with zero semantics; the backend is determined solely by each entry's `type` field.

defaults.description: Role → config-label map. Roles select which labeled config plays which part.

primary.description: Label of the config for the coding/interactive role

fast.description: Label of the config for the compression role (distill, compaction)

use_distilled.description: Whether to prefer distilled versions of fragments/prompts (default: true)

statusline.description: Whether ctxloom manages its HUD statusline (default: true); set false to keep your own

auto_sync.description: Automatically sync remote dependencies on startup (default: true)

auto_register_ctxloom.description: Whether to automatically register ctxloom's own MCP server (default: true)

servers.description: Unified MCP server configurations (applied to all backends)

plugins.description: Backend-specific MCP server configurations (keyed by backend name)

definitions.description: Named collections of context fragments and variables

llm.description: Preferred LLM config label/backend to launch for this profile (overridable by `run --llm`)

parents.description: Parent profiles to inherit from (processed depth-first)

tags.description: Fragment tags to include (fragments with matching tags are added)

fragments.description: Explicit fragment references to include: a plain path string, or an object with a name and optional priority (FragmentRef.UnmarshalYAML accepts both)

priority.description: Higher = more important; bookend-placed in context (default: 0)

variables.description: Variable values for template substitution in fragments

hooks.description: Hooks configuration for this profile (inherited from parents)

exclude_fragments.description: Fragment names to exclude from this profile (filtered after inheritance)

exclude_mcp.description: MCP server names to exclude from this profile (filtered after inheritance)

workspace.description: Project default for the SESSION-level workspace axis: where a session's working directory lives. 'none' (default) is the shared live project dir; 'worktree' gives each session its own git worktree. Overridden per invocation by run/map/weave --workspace. Deliberately not an agent trait — needing a private cwd is a property of how a session is launched (an unrecognized value degrades to none with a warning).

runtime.description: Project default for the AGENT-level runtime axis: where an agent's engine process executes. 'host' (default) runs on the host; 'container' runs it inside the backend's agent image. An agent binding's own `runtime` overrides this default (an unrecognized value degrades to host with a warning). Independent of `workspace` — the two axes are never bound together.

isolation_images.description: Per-backend USER-PROVIDED agent images for containerized runs, keyed by backend name (claude-code, kiro, ...). An entry overrides the built-in per-backend default tag and is run as-is: never locally built or overlaid, and an absent image degrades with a warning instead of triggering the on-the-fly build. Missing entries keep the built-in default (auto-built when absent).

isolation_base_containerfile.description: USER-PROVIDED base Containerfile for locally-built agent images: local builds (on-the-fly and `ctxloom container build`) build the shared base stage from this file — your tools, your certs — and layer the engine's agent stage on top, instead of using the embedded default base. Relative paths resolve against the project root.

agents.description: Local-only engine↔profile bindings. An agent names an engine (LLM config label/backend) and the profiles composed into one assembled context. LOCAL ONLY — never shipped in a bundle or remote; may also be declared as .ctxloom/agents/<name>.yaml files.

engine.description: LLM config label/backend hoisted to this agent; overrides the composed profiles' llm (optional; empty falls back to the profiles' llm, then the project default backend)

profiles.description: Profiles composed into one assembled context (later wins / union). Members may be local, top-level remote, or bundle profiles (<bundle>#profiles/<name>).

runtime.description: Runtime axis for this agent: where its engine process executes. Overrides the top-level `runtime` default; empty inherits it, then falls back to host. The workspace axis is a session trait (run/map/weave --workspace), never declared on an agent.

permissions.description: Launch-time permission posture for this agent; empty inherits the engine label's default, then the built-in default.

default_agent.description: The always-bound default agent: names an entry in `agents` (or a .ctxloom/agents/<name>.yaml file) that a bare `ctxloom run` (no --agent, no -p/-f/-t) resolves — its composed profiles become the context and its engine + runtime + permissions the transport. Replaces the retired profiles.defaults: 'the default profile set' is now whatever this agent composes. Empty or naming an undefined agent degrades to empty context with a warning (never a hard stop).

llmConfig.description: One labeled backend config. `type` is the discriminator and may be omitted (it defaults to claude-code — see LLMConfig.EffectiveType); the remaining fields are that backend's own config. anyOf (not oneOf): an entry without `type` is shape-compatible with several branches and must still validate.

permissions.description: Launch-time permission posture: default (prompt) | acceptEdits | plan (read-only) | bypass (skip all prompts).
